scope: reference PXA255/PXA270 emulation, not Blue Angel hardware
known_model_limitations: timer state survives system_reset while PIC resets
OIER disabled match does not latch OSSR
OIER disable does not lower already-raised IRQ
generic16550 does not model all PXA UUE/clock behavior
baseline_decision: Keep immutable QEMU9.1 as regression oracle; port audited PXA26x subset into a separate modern-QEMU board in E2, retain known limitations as explicit tests.
